blocks.caption: Arranging a courier and reporting problems · Customer & Agent

runs.text: Alone, read the clerk or agent's question, answer aloud, and then rehearse both roles. These are practice scenarios; no real shipment is required.

You want a package delivered by Friday. Ask about the two quote options, give their price/tracking/date replies, and clarify whether either date is guaranteed. Choose an option or explain why you need to ask about another service.
You have a pickup notice but do not know the identification requirements. Explain why you came and ask what you need.
A driver arrives at apartment 14, but you live in apartment 4 and the addressee is unfamiliar. Clarify the address.
, but you have not received the package. State the discrepancy and ask how to request a review.

“What are my options for delivery by Friday? Is that date guaranteed?” — “Basic is twelve dollars; Faster is nineteen. Both include tracking, but neither date is guaranteed.” / “I'm here to pick up a package. What ID do you need?” / “This is apartment four. I think you have the wrong address.” / “It says delivered, but I haven't received it. How can I request a review?”
Try again with a new destination or problem. Check that you stated what was sent or received and asked about the information you still needed.
